name: Beneficiary Certification Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of beneficiary's certification.

ACCI.name: Accredited Investor
ACCI.definition: The holder of the security has to irrevocably certify that it is an Accredited Investor as defined in US Securities and Exchange Commission Regulation D.

DOMI.name: Domicile Country
DOMI.definition: The holder of the security has to certify his domicile.

FULL.name: Full Beneficial Owner Breakdown
FULL.definition: The holder of the security has to provide his beneficial owner details for disclosure/instruction purpose.

QIBB.name: QIB Certification
QIBB.definition: The holder of the security has to irrevocably certify that it is a Qualified Institutional Buyer as defined in US Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 144A.

TRBD.name: Tax Rate Breakdown
TRBD.definition: The holder of the security has to provide basic details on nominals and associated tax rate to be used by the account servicer.

NCOM.name: Non Company
NCOM.definition: The holder of the security has to certify he is an Non-Company related person.
